run_regret_minimizer_step: run the regret minimizer step method to advance the population distribution by one iteration
compress_nus_and_weights: compress the stored population distributions by filtering out low-weight members using L1 optimization
compute_regrets: compute the current external or internal regrets for all policies given true or modified rewards
compute_average_regret: compute the algorithm's average regret across all policies using normalized nu weights
step_for: run the regret minimizer for T steps with optional welfare bonus and early stopping based on regret threshold
